description: Backend contract for the student-site platform. Every slot of the template (index.html) described as data. The student workspace renders forms from this, the validation engine gates from this, the exporter consumes the same shape. Companion doc: CONTRACT.md.

slots.name: hero-kicker
slots.guidance: Greeting line above the title. Pattern: 'Hi, my name is {author-name}' (variants welcome).

slots.name: site-title
slots.guidance: Main headline of the hero. Plain text, no markup.

slots.name: hero-subtitle
slots.guidance: One welcoming sentence under the title.

slots.name: about-me
slots.guidance:
One paragraph about the student, wrapped in

...

. The only slot where markup is allowed.

slots.name: footer-text
slots.default: Made with AI as my co-pilot. I am the Operator.

slots.name: author-name
slots.guidance: Student alias (pseudonym), shown in the footer credit. No real full names.

slots.name: background
slots.guidance: Thematic photo matching the student's story. NO people, NO text, NO watermarks. Atmospheric, not distracting (theme scrim sits on top).

slots.name: avatar
slots.guidance: AI-generated only, personal photos are forbidden. Transparent background: pixels with alpha < 128 produce no particles, so the particle shape follows the silhouette.

format.step: sampling grid step in px (4 for 256px avatars)
format.points: [[x, y, luminance], ...] - luminance is 0-255 (Rec.601/709 weighted), pixels with alpha < 128 are skipped

particles.luminanceNote: particles.js consumes luminance as l = value / 100, so values above 100 saturate (brighter, larger particles). This is the gallery-approved look - do not 'normalize' to 0-100.

runtime.budgetRule: deviceMemory<=2 or cores<=2 -> 700; mobile or mem<=4 or cores<=4 -> 1400; else 3000

contentRules: Avatar is AI-generated only; personal photos forbidden
Background and all photos: no people, no text, no watermarks
Student identified by alias only (author-name), never a real full name
